evidence.requirements: Start page meets the brief: heading, name links, family, L3, Search/Family filters, '<n> cartridges' (app.js:44-89, list.jpg). The detail view has the heading, alternative names, facts, water capacity with its source link, tables with Symbol/Value/Unit, Print, 'All cartridges' and a hash route (app.js:154-187, browse.js:53-63). The SVG uses 1 unit = 1 mm, has a hatched section, dash-dot centre line and title block. Partly met: (1) the shoulder angle α has no arrowheads or extension lines. It is a bare 6 mm arc at the cone apex on the axis (drawing.js:265-292, 363-365), far from the shoulder: inside the neck/bullet on 308 Win. and past the bullet tip on 9,3 x 74 R (stray tick on the centre line at the right in detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg). (2) Rule 9: when r1 min or r2 is missing the fillet is skipped without a note (geometry.js:301-302), e.g. 338 Lapua (no r1Min) and 17 HMR. (3) The title block says 'Scale 1:1' (drawing.js:476) although the drawing is scaled to the screen or page width. Empty sections render header-only tables ('Junction cone' in detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-22_long_rifle.jpg, detail-44_rem_mag.jpg).
evidence.correctness: Rim type, chamfer (f·tanβ capped at R1/4), groove floor/ramp, belt ramp at δ, body, shoulder with fillets, neck, bullet seating/k/meplat, tangent ogive, heeled 22 LR, walls tn/tb, w and primer pockets follow rules 1-8 (geometry.js:64-383). They match the reference proportions (308_win.png vs detail-308_win.jpg; 22_long_rifle.png rounded rim vs detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). Labels match the data with tolerances ('L1 39.62 -0.2', 'R 1.4 -0.25'), angles show as 10°58'00". Print fits one A4 page (print-308_win.jpg). Wrong: the α dimension sweeps only the half angle (from the axis to the shoulder line) but is labelled with the included angle. It sits at the apex z = L1 + (P2/2)/tan(α/2) (≈55.5 mm on 308, ≈113 mm on 9,3 x 74 R) with no line to the shoulder, so it reads as a stray mark. The section bullet is not hatched. Straight cases blend the wall from tb to tn over the whole body (documented in the README).
evidence.security: All record text goes through esc() before the SVG string is set with innerHTML (drawing.js:40-42, 533-573). The DOM is built with textContent/setAttribute (app.js:15-30). No fetch, eval or external resources; index.html loads only local files.
evidence.code_quality: Clear split into data, format, browse, geometry and drawing modules. UMD wrappers let Node tests use the same code. The geometry functions are pure with named rules. Downsides: drawing.js is a dense 590 lines; labelFor and lengthText rebuild every section for each label/row (drawing.js:49-62, app.js:36-40); the α spec computes values that are never connected to the shoulder; rebated is detected but has no effect.
evidence.tests: Node test runner, 5 files. They cover rim types, chamfer, rimfire half-round, groove, belt, bottleneck points, α, straight case, seating/k/meplat, ogive radius, heel, walls, w, pockets, missing-value notes, formatting/units/tolerances, search/filter/count/routes, and label collisions plus viewBox for all 25 records (geometry.test.js, drawing.test.js:56-73). Missing: DOM/detail-view rendering, print CSS, file:// loading, fillets, flat/semi-wadcutter bullets, and placement of the α dimension, which is how the misplaced arc got through.
evidence.ux_design: Dense, calm reference layout: facts as a dl, two-column grouped tables in tabular mono numbers, labels clear of the outline. The print layout is excellent (print-308_win.jpg: four-column facts, 4-column tables, footer). Weak points: label and title-block text size varies about 2× between cartridges because text is in mm and the SVG scales to width (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg vs detail-308_win.jpg). The title block takes about a quarter of the figure. Long slanted leaders run to one label row. Empty header-only tables. Dark mode is supported in CSS but not shown in the screenshots.
evidence.accessibility: SVG has role=img and aria-label '<name> drawing' (drawing.js:533). Inputs have labels (app.js:76-77), the count is aria-live, tables use th scope=col/row, there is a h1/h2/h3 hierarchy, :focus-visible outlines, lang=en, and muted text has adequate contrast. Gaps: focus is not moved to the new h1 on route change; tables have no caption or aria association with their h3; the drawing has no longer text description.
evidence.simplicity: No runtime or dev dependencies (package.json), plain classic scripts, about 1,500 lines of JS. The candidate-based label placer with Liang-Barsky collision checks is elaborate but serves the no-overlap requirement.
evidence.maintainability: README covers opening from disk or a server, npm test, and the drawing assumptions. package.json has version 1.0.0 and engines node>=22. There is no CI pipeline, no .nvmrc or exact runtime pin, no changelog or release process, and openspec/specs holds only .gitkeep, so there are no specs or ADRs. The README says short cases put the title block beside the drawing, but the 9 mm and 22 LR screenshots show it below.
evidence.visual_design: Neutral palette, consistent spacing and type across the list and detail pages, thin rules, small-caps table headers; it looks finished (detail-308_win.jpg, list.jpg). The type scale inside the drawing is inconsistent between cartridges, and the oversized title block on short cases looks heavy (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg).
evidence.layout: Order is name, facts, drawing, tables, footer, with no overlaps or clipping seen. On short cases the title block plus empty space under the dimensions takes almost as much height as the drawing (detail-22_long_rifle.jpg, detail-44_rem_mag.jpg). Empty Junction cone tables waste rows, and the shoulder labels crowd the right end with long diagonal leaders (detail-300_win_mag.jpg).
evidence.usability: Search as you type matches alternative names and ignores spacing (browse.js:21-40). Family filter, live count, and filter state kept when returning via 'All cartridges' (app.js:12-13). Bookmarkable hashes, a not-found page, and a one-click Print. No feedback beyond '0 cartridges' on an empty search.
evidence.reception: Reloaders and engineers would trust the precise tables, as-published values and clean print sheet. A careful engineer would notice the floating α arc, the 'Scale 1:1' claim on a scaled drawing, and the empty tables, which cost some credibility.

unmet_requirements: Shoulder angle α dimension lacks arrowheads/extension lines and is drawn as a half-angle arc at the cone apex, detached from the shoulder (inside the neck on 308 Win., beyond the bullet tip on 9,3 x 74 R)
Rule 9 partly met: missing r1 min / r2 fillets are skipped without naming the missing value (e.g. 338 Lapua Mag., 17 HMR)
Title block states 'Scale 1:1' although the drawing is scaled to the screen/page width, so the scale is not stated truthfully
strengths: Geometry follows rules 1-8 closely (chamfer, rimfire half-round, groove, belt at δ, fillets, tangent ogive, heeled bullet, walls, primer pocket) and matches the reference proportions
Excellent one-page A4 print: black on white, full-width legible drawing, compact multi-column tables, source footer
Zero-dependency, cleanly modular code with meaningful unit tests, including label-collision checks for all 25 drawings
issues: The α shoulder-angle dimension is wrong: a half-angle arc floating at the cone apex with no extension lines or arrowheads, labelled with the included angle
Missing fillet values (r1 min, r2) are omitted silently, contrary to rule 9; the title block claims 'Scale 1:1' for a scaled drawing
Inconsistent drawing typography and an oversized title block on short cases, empty header-only tables, and no CI, specs or ADRs for maintainers
review.verdict: This is a careful, dependency-free build: case and bullet geometry are true to the rules, values are shown as published, and the print sheet is excellent. The broken shoulder-angle dimension, silent omission of missing fillet values and the misleading scale note need fixing before it goes to an engineering audience.
